title: Samal Island resort denies ownership link to Rep. Paolo Duterte
summary: The Casas Con Vistas Resort in Pangubatan, Island Garden City of Samal on Wednesday denied reports linking its ownership to Davao City First District Representative Paolo "Pulong" Duterte.
